notes.title: Update 2.0a - October 01 2017
notes.notes:
Hello!
New in 2.0a:

You did not expect us? We are working on the game and do not plan to stop! We want to create an excellent game and there is always something to work on!
This is not an early access, so we release only major updates, the next is planned for 2018 ... There will be a lot of interesting! And here's what we did now:


 Added. The new mode of the game is Fight Mode. Now you can destroy aliens using cold steel weapons and gain maximum points!
 Added. The new game mode is Endless Mode. Did you just want to shoot the aliens? Now you have such an opportunity! Try to score the maximum number of points!
 Added. The main menu of the game has been updated.
 Added. Changed the interface, which showed how many lives you have left. Now it's convenient and beautiful!
 Added. New effect of attacking aliens! Now it's easier to navigate and it's immediately clear that you were hit by an enemy! Looks really cool!
 Added. New objects and locations.
 Added. Many small changes and additions.

 Fix. Sounds of aliens.
 Fix. Environment sounds.
 Fix. Optimization and improved performance.
 Fix. Improved AI enemies.
 Fix. Improved text and font in the menu.
 Fix. Improved drawing and detailing for HTC Vive.
 Fix. Fixed bugs in the menu and in some locations.
 Fix. The rectangle surrounding the player is removed in all locations.
 Fix. Improved weapon responsiveness.

 And more small changes.


We plan to release 3.0 before the end of 2018.
Thank you for your support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː
